title: Sinosauropteryx: Complete Overview
name: Sinosauropteryx: Complete Overview
description: Sinosauropteryx ("Chinese lizard wing") was a carnivore dinosaur of the Early Cretaceous (125 million years ago), reaching about 1 m. First feathered dinosaur discovered.     ("What does the name Sinosauropteryx mean?", "Chinese lizard wing"),
